title: Dogecoin Update: Support, Resistance, and Future Price #shorts
description: Dogecoin is currently consolidating over 8 cents, establishing a base. Watch for a potential break above 11-13.5 cents resistance, but be aware of potential rejection. Breaking this resistance is key to invalidating the downtrend and targeting upside. #Dogecoin #CryptoUpdate #TechnicalAnalysis #Altcoins

asr.full_text: Good morning, everyone. It's crypto me analysis coming at you with an update video on Dogecoin. So first and foremost, if you can please like and subscribe to the channel. I would greatly appreciate it. I haven't for the most part for the last couple of years and weekly update videos ever started off with that. But I do need to grow my channels, so I am trying something different now. So please hit the subscribe button. If you're not subscribed, I do do make weekly update videos and for the most part i live stream every single day so without wasting any more of your time um nothing has changed from last week's update video with dogecoin you are still consolidating sideways you are consolidating over the uh over support at eight cents and you're establishing a base so once we do turn bullish and once we get some sort of relief rally i do see dogecoin attempting to break this area of resistance overhead at around 11 to 13 cents and a half keep in mind you can still come up here get stuck and get rejected at this level again sending you back down to these lows so you do need to break this area of resistance and then we can start invalidating this downtrend and looking That pretty much does it so I'll keep you updated. Thank you so much for your support and I'll catch you in my next video!

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides a Dogecoin technical-analysis update about consolidation above an eight-cent support level. The discussion is conditional and acknowledges possible rejection at resistance and a return to prior lows, framing it as uncertain analysis rather than a guaranteed return. The request to like and subscribe is an ordinary engagement appeal, not a condition for receiving money or investment returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content is conditional market analysis of Dogecoin support, resistance, and possible rejection, rather than a stated participation pathway or guaranteed return.
